title: Stake TAO from Solana
sub: A real run, with real funds
say: This is a real run on soltao. TAO in a Solana wallet, staked on Bittensor, in a wallet only I hold.

title: 1. Connect your Solana wallet
points: Phantom, Solflare or any standard wallet
The page reads your canonical TAO
It shows the staking minimum up front
say: First, connect a Solana wallet. The page reads how much canonical TAO you hold, and tells you up front how much staking needs.

title: 2. Sign in once
points: Your Bittensor wallet is created in the browser
The same wallet every time you sign in
say: Next, sign in once. That signature moves no funds. Your browser turns it into your Bittensor wallet, and it is the same wallet every time you come back.

title: 3. Choose where to stake
points: Validators from the subnet's own on-chain list
Wrong validators are refused before you sign
say: Then choose where to stake. Root, or any subnet. Validators come from that subnet's own list on chain, and a validator with no slot is refused before you can sign.

title: 4. Review every fee
points: soltao's flat 0.003 SOL, with its address
Fees as a share of what you send
say: Before anything is signed, you see every fee. soltao's flat fee with its address, the bridge fees in dollars, and what share of your amount they are.

title: 5. One Solana transaction
points: The bridge carries TAO to Bittensor
The page stakes it and hands it to your wallet
Close the tab and it resumes from the chain
say: Approve one Solana transaction. The bridge carries your TAO to Bittensor, and the page stakes it and hands it to your wallet. If you close the tab, it picks up from the chain where it left off.

title: 6. Your position, on chain
points: Bring TAO back to the same Solana wallet
say: Your position shows straight from the chain. From here you can unstake all or part, and bring your TAO back to the same Solana wallet.

title: soltao.xyz
say: That's soltao. Try it at soltao dot x y z.
